title: Quantifying the Extent to Which Race and Gender Features Determine Identity in Commercial Face Recognition Algorithms
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not analyze or measure any aspect of faith or religion. The focus is on race and gender bias in face recognition algorithms.
findings: The paper does not contain any findings related to religion, as its focus is on race and gender in biometric algorithms.
